## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests / CI

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests locally.
- [ ] I checked compatibility with the affected Python/OS targets.
- [ ] I did not include private machine data, credentials, or tokens.
- [ ] I updated documentation when CLI, SDK, dashboard, or setup behavior changed.

## Notes

Add benchmark results, sanitized logs, screenshots, or compatibility notes when useful.
